license_required.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501, and amendments thereto.

name.quote: "Board" means the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501, and amendments thereto.

type.quote: the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501

moral_character_required.quote: Who is of good moral character; and in determining the moral character of any such person, the board may take into consideration any felony conviction of such person, but such conviction shall not automatically operate as a bar to licensure

degree_required.value: Graduation from a school or college of optometry approved by the board
degree_required.quote: who has graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board

exams.name: Board examination
exams.quote: who successfully meets and completes the requirements set by the board and passes an examination given by the board

exams.name: Kansas law examination (for reciprocal licensure)
exams.quote: successfully passes an examination of Kansas law administered by the board and such clinical practice examination as the board deems necessary

interval_years.quote: Any license to practice optometry issued by the board shall expire on May 31 of the year specified by the board for the expiration of the license and shall be renewed on a biennial basis

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The biennial renewal fee shall not exceed $800.

required.quote: In addition to the payment of the license renewal fee, each licensee applying for license renewal shall furnish to the secretary of the board satisfactory evidence of successfully completing a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

period_years.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

value: 5 hours of ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics
topical_requirements.quote: five hours of which shall relate to ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics of study

available.quote: Any applicant for reciprocal licensure may in the board's discretion be licensed and issued a license without examination if the applicant has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure

requirements.value: Must have been in active practice in another state for at least 3 years immediately preceding application; must present certified copy of license from another state with equivalent requirements; must submit sworn statement that license has never been limited, suspended or revoked; must pass Kansas law examination and clinical practice examination as deemed necessary by board; must pay reciprocal license fee not to exceed $450
requirements.quote: the applicant has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure and the applicant: (1) Presents a certified copy of a certificate of registration or license which has been issued to the applicant by another state where the requirements for licensure are deemed by the board to be equivalent to the requirements for licensure under this act, if such state accords a like privilege to holders of a license issued by the board; (2) submits a sworn statement of the licensing authority of such other state that the applicant's license has never been limited, suspended or revoked and that the applicant has never been censured or had other disciplinary action taken; (3) successfully passes an examination of Kansas law administered by the board and such clinical practice examination as the board deems necessary; and (4) pays the reciprocal license fixed by the board by rules and regulations in an amount of not to exceed $450

exists.quote: the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501

regulatory_model.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

credential_type.quote: A person shall be qualified to be licensed and to receive a license as an optometrist

is_mandatory.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

title_protection.quote: a person shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of the optometry law if such person in any manner: (1) Holds oneself out to the public as being engaged in or who maintains an office for the practice of optometry as defined in K.S.A. 65-1501

scope_protection.quote: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of unprofessional conduct as defined in statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraudulent or false advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has used fraudulent or false advertisements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of optometry law, pharmacy act, or uniform controlled substances act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has willfully or repeatedly violated the optometry law, the pharmacy act of the state of Kansas or the uniform controlled substances act, or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated an order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay renewal fees specified in the act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to pay renewal fees specified in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with annual continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to comply with the annual continuing education requirements as required by this act and the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or impersonation of another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has engaged in the practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, alcoholism, drug abuse, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has the inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, alcoholism, excessive use of drugs, controlled substances, chemical or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, limited, censured, or other disciplinary action taken by another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has had a license to practice optometry revoked, suspended or limited, has been censured or has had other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license denied, by the proper licensing authority of another state, territory, District of Columbia, or other country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of lawful rules and regulations promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated any lawful rules and regulations promulgated by the board or violated any lawful order or directive of the board previously entered by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the validity of the examination for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has cheated on or attempted to subvert the validity of the examination for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, or incompetent to stand trial
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, not guilty because the licensee suffers from a mental disease or defect or incompetent to stand trial by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board or its investigators any information legally requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to furnish the board, or its investigators or representatives, any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctions or disciplinary actions taken by peer review committee, health care facility, or professional association
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sanctions or disciplinary actions have been taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, health care facility or a professional association or society for acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse action taken by another state or licensing jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state or licensing jurisdiction, a peer review body, a health care facility, a professional association or society, a governmental agency, by a law enforcement agency or a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of license or professional staff membership while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has surrendered a license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or has surrendered the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report surrender of license or professional staff membership while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board surrender of the licensee's license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse judgment, award or settlement from medical liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has an adverse judgment, award or settlement against the licensee resulting from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse judgment, settlement or award from malpractice liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award against the licensee resulting from a malpractice liability claim

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain professional liability insurance as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402 or 40-3403a, and amendments thereto, or pay the annual premium as required by K.S.A. 40-3404, and amendments thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitted misleading, deceptive, false or fraudulent representation on claim form, bill or statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has knowingly submitted any misleading, deceptive, false or fraudulent representation on a claim form bill or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide patient with written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses after eye examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to provide to a patient the patient's written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses subsequent to the completion of the eye examination in accordance with applicable state or federal law.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof; (2) the prescribing, dispensing or adapting of lenses (including any ophthalmic lenses which are classified as drugs by any law of the United States or of this state), prisms, low vision rehabilitation services, orthoptic exercises and visual training therapy for the relief of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae; and (3) the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma.

drug_authority.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include: (1) The management and treatment of glaucoma, except as provided in subsection (a); (2) the performance of surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes, except that licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids; remove eyelashes; scrape the cornea for diagnostic tests, smears or cultures; dilate, probe, irrigate or close by punctal plug the tear drainage structures of the eye; express conjunctival follicles or cysts; debridement of the corneal epithelium and co-management of post-operative care; or (3) the performance of procedures requiring anesthesia administered by injection or general anesthesia.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Under the direction and supervision of a licensee, a licensed professional nurse, licensed practical nurse, licensed physical therapist and licensed occupational therapist may assist in the provision of low vision rehabilitation services

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: No contact lens prescription may be limited by an expiration date or otherwise to a period of less than 12 months from either the date the prescription is first determined or the last date of the contact lens evaluation by a licensed optometrist or a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery, whichever date is later, unless a health related reason for the limitation is noted in the patient's medical record.

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: The licensee has failed to provide to a patient the patient's written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses subsequent to the completion of the eye examination in accordance with applicable state or federal law.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The payment of the renewal fee by the person who is a holder of a license as an optometrist but who has not complied with the continuing education requirements fixed by the board, if no grounds exist for denying the renewal of the license other than that the person has not complied with the continuing education requirements fixed by the board, shall entitle the person to inactive status licensure by the board.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: successfully passes an examination of Kansas law administered by the board

criminal_background_check_required.quote: The board may require an applicant for licensure or a licensee in connection with an investigation of the licensee to be fingerprinted and submit to a state and national criminal history record check
